title: A quickstart patch release with no profile of its own version is bound to the nearest lower profile of the same major
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test apps/tracy-web/test/contracts.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail counts and the test named for the nearest-lower fallback.
expect: contractFor(index, '<release>', '1.0.3') with only a 1.0.0 profile returns that profile with id '<release>/1.0.0' and fallbackFrom '1.0.3'.
An exact profile wins; a higher version, another major or another release is never returned; a non-semver version returns null.
mayName treats a release served by a fallback profile as having a contract.
evidence: Patch releases JA Nova 1.1.5, Essence 1.0.3, Impact 1.0.3 had no profile of their own version, so provisioning bound no contract (catalogue `contract` empty).
fence: The lookup rule in contractFor; the bound id stays the profile's own id (a plain string)

tests: a UI patch release falls back to the nearest LOWER profile
a release served by a fallback profile may be named
